# eurodns_gate_role (Resource)

A role of the eurodns-gate managed policy, owned by a policy delegation of the gate (gate mode only). The gate validates it against the delegation of the provider identity and activates the change at once, without approval. Bind it with `eurodns_gate_binding`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Gate mode only. The provider identity must be a subject of a policy
# delegation of the gate (policy.delegations); the role must stay within it.
resource "eurodns_gate_role" "web" {
  name        = "eurodns-gate-web"
  description = "DNS names of the web pipeline"
  rules = [{
    zones   = ["example.com"]
    actions = ["dns.read", "dns.record.write"]
    hosts   = ["web.apps", "_acme-challenge.web.apps"]
    types   = ["CNAME", "TXT"]
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role in the gate, a lowercase identifier (`[a-z0-9._-]`, up to 64 characters). Changing it replaces the role.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Grants of the role. Each rule must stay within the delegation of the provider identity (`allow.zones`, `allow.actions`, `allow.records`) and within `policy.bounds` of the gate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Optional

- `delegation` (String) Gate delegation (`policy.delegations[].name`) that owns the role. Needed only when the provider identity matches several delegations; otherwise the gate picks the only one. Changing it replaces the role.
- `description` (String) Free text shown in the gate UI.
- `ephemeral_ttl` (String) Go duration after which the RRsets created through the role expire and are removed by the gate (ACME challenges), for example `24h`.
- `max_changes_per_request` (Number) Blast-radius limit (RRset changes per request), `0` for the gate default, at most 1000.
- `rebase_on_save` (Boolean) On a full-zone PUT, ignore differences outside the role's scope instead of refusing them (stale zones sent by ACME clients). Default `false`.

### Read-Only

- `etag` (String) Version of the role in the gate, sent back as `If-Match` on updates so that a concurrent change is detected.
- `id` (String) The name.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `actions` (List of String) Actions: `dns.read`, `dns.record.write`, `dns.record.adopt`, `dns.zone.admin`, `domain.read`, `ui.read` (as far as the delegation allows; `policy.*` actions are never delegated).
- `zones` (List of String) Zone globs (`*` wildcards), for example `example.com` or `*.example.com`.

Optional:

- `hosts` (List of String) Host patterns relative to the zone: `@` is the apex, `*` one label, `**` one or more labels. Omit to cover every host (if the delegation allows it).
- `types` (List of String) Record types, `*` for any. Omit to cover every type (if the delegation allows it).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name. Only roles owned by a delegation of the provider identity can be
# imported (delegated roles).
terraform import eurodns_gate_role.web eurodns-gate-web
```
